placements.why: This envelope's entire content is a calibration verification record for a named instrument (Kestrelwood spectrograph) — a frequency setting checked against a dated reference artifact and confirmed to hold across its operating range. No existing strata category was supplied to hold organizational content of this shape (instrument readiness/verification as opposed to Opportunity, Strategy, Product, Architecture, Organization, Proof, or Templates), and the graph structure is empty, so no narrative leaf can host it either without a home category. This names a recurring organizational subject — future calibration runs on this or other instruments will keep feeding it — not a one-time fact, satisfying the narrative-grain test at the strata tier.
placements.title: instrument readiness is established through verified calibration
placements.frame: what instrument, at what setting, was verified against what reference, and does the org treat that verification as settling the instrument's readiness?

placements.title: an instrument's calibration is trusted once checked against a dated reference and shown to hold
placements.frame: what instrument and setting were verified, against which reference artifact, and over what range does the verification hold?
placements.why: src-1 asserts the Kestrelwood spectrograph is now calibrated at 88.4 MHz and that this was verified against the June reference plates, holding across the full observing band; src-2 and src-3 restate the same instrument, calibration value, and verification provenance as catalog fields (per the position pass's single KestrelwoodCalibrationVerified grouping and the register pass's flat instrumental-catalog reading). This is a directional theme — verified calibration as the basis for trusting an instrument's readiness — that future calibration envelopes (other instruments, other reference dates) will keep feeding, not a one-time measurement to be filed as a bare fact. No existing leaf was supplied to hold it, so it mints fresh under the newly-minted Calibration stratum rather than standing unparented.
